notes: Cloud save, class-aware recovery tutorial, and Collection screen layout polish.
fixes: Cloud save — signing into your account now restores your full collection, deck, academy progress, and Vials on any device.
New account profile rows are created automatically on first email sign-in — no more silent failures after account creation.

Recovery Academy lesson 6 (Recovery & Revive) now shows your class's own recovery skill instead of always using Hope's revive — Courage learns Face It Head-On, Serenity learns Sanctuary of Serenity, Purpose learns Daily Progress.
Evolution blocked until Turn 4 — orbs are greyed out and an error message appears if you try earlier.
Tutorial lesson 6 (Recovery & Revive) freeze fixed — Hope path now correctly waits for the enemy to attack before prompting the revive.
Collection screen layout rebuilt — craft-cost guide and currency panel no longer overlap; search, filters, and card binder each sit in their own row.
Epic craft cost updated to 2,500 Vials. Legendary craft cost updated to 3,500 Vials.
CREATE buttons throughout Collection and Deck Builder now show formatted costs with commas (e.g. 2,500).
features: Reduced Legendaries to 3 per class; added 7 Bronze and 5 Silver per class
Academy Lesson 1 redesigned — visual zone tiles, no walls of text, progression fixed.
Recovery Academy rebuilt — 6 lessons now run inside real battles with live followers.
Class balance complete — all 4 classes now even: 6 Bronze / 5 Silver / 7 Gold / 6 Epic / 5 Legendary / 1 Platinum each (147 cards total).
The Sponsor shiny art updated — holographic platinum light rays and rainbow iridescence.
Sponsor Evolution cinematic — moody diner backdrop plays when The Sponsor evolves.
Sponsor Trial reward — defeating The Sponsor for the first time awards a Shiny Platinum copy.
Walking Free (JD-060) cost lowered from 10 to 6.
The Undaunted (JD-140) art corrected — clean look, no tattoos.
Tutorial overlay — mentor banner stays at top of battle screen during Academy lessons.
Lesson progression — completing a battle lesson auto-returns you to the Academy.

CLOUD SAVE — Your account now backs up your full game state to the cloud automatically after every save. Sign in on any device to restore your collection, deck, academy progress, and Vials exactly where you left off.

CLASS RECOVERY TUTORIAL — Academy lesson 6 is now personalised to your chosen class. Courage players learn Face It Head-On (attack the leader to gain Progress). Serenity players learn Sanctuary of Serenity (heal your leader to buff allies). Purpose players learn Daily Progress (spend all Play Points then End Turn). Hope players see the original Recovery Call revive lesson.
Academy zone lesson redesigned — visual zone tiles, no long text, fixed progression bug so players can advance past Lesson 1.
The Undaunted (JD-140) art corrected — clean chest, no tattoos.
CLASS BALANCE COMPLETE — All four classes (Hope, Courage, Serenity, Purpose) are now perfectly even across every rarity tier: 6 Bronze, 5 Silver, 7 Gold, 6 Epic, 5 Legendary, 1 Platinum each.
SPONSOR SHINY ART — The Sponsor's shiny/platinum copy now renders dedicated holographic art: platinum light rays, rainbow iridescence, and a 'ONE DAY AT A TIME' mug baked into the image.
SPONSOR EVOLUTION CINEMATIC — When The Sponsor evolves, a moody rain-streaked diner scene fades in behind the card as the backdrop, grounding the moment in a real place.
EASTER EGG CARDS — Two hidden Legendary cards have been added to the pool. Find them if you can.

RECOVERY ACADEMY REBUILT — Six lessons now run inside the real battle scene with followers on the field. Play a Follower, Combat, End Your Turn, Spells & Amulets, Recovery & Revive, and Sponsor & Sponsee all use live gameplay instead of static UI panels.
TUTORIAL OVERLAY — A fixed mentor banner appears at the top of the battle screen during Academy lessons, showing the lesson name, mentor, and step-by-step instructions that update as you progress.

SCRIPTED ENEMY TURN — During Recovery & Revive (lesson 5) the opponent attacks your follower on their first turn, putting it into the Relapse Zone so you can practice the recover mechanic immediately.
LESSON PROGRESSION — Completing a battle lesson automatically increments your Academy step and returns you to the Academy screen, ready for the next lesson.
CLASS BALANCE — All four classes now have equal card counts per rarity: 5 Bronze, 3 Silver, 4 Gold, 2 Epic, 4 Legendary, 1 Platinum each.
COPY LIMITS EXPANDED — Legendaries now allow 3 copies per deck (up from 2). Platinums, Signature Platinums, and Signature Golds now allow 2 copies per deck (up from 1). Epics remain at 3.
SPONSOR TRIAL CINEMATIC — Battling The Sponsor plays a dedicated cinematic intro before the battle loads.
SPONSOR TRIAL REWARD — Defeating The Sponsor for the first time awards a ✨ Shiny Platinum copy.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
